definition: the state of (three or more long flexible things) being intertwined, interlaced or braided together.
example: ಅವಳು ಮೂರು ಹಗ್ಗಗಳ ಹೆಣಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಚ್ಚಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She tried to untie the braiding of the three ropes.

definition: the creeper Cucumis elo (= C. aromaticus, = C. utilissinus) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example: ಕಂಕಡಿ ಬಳ್ಳಿಯು ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೇಲಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಬ್ಬಿದೆ.
example_en: The Cucumis elo creeper has spread over the fence in front of the house.

definition: any bristlelike fibre or fibres, as on the head of wheat, barley, paddy, etc. awn.
example_en: The awn of the wheat ear pricks a lot.

definition: the lower front part of the human body between the chest and thighs; the abdomen; the belly.
example_en: His belly has grown large.

definition: name of a sage-author who wrote Kāma Śastra.
example_en: The students read the Kama Shastra text written by the sage Vatsyayana.

definition: fondness; affection; liking.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಗೆ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The grandmother had great fondness for her grandchild.

definition: a kind of large drum.
example_en: The artists led the procession playing the large drum.

definition: to tie fast.
example_en: He tied the rope fast to the pillar.

definition: the state or fact of being an owner; ownership.
example: ಆ ತೋಟದ ಹಿಡುವಳಿ ಅವನ ಅಜ್ಜನಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: The ownership of that garden has come down from his grandfather.

definition: earnest, steady effort; constant diligence in or application to work.
example_en: His diligent effort is a model for everyone.

definition: the fact of having and controlling property; the relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others; the state or fact of being an owner; ownership.
example: ಆ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯ ಈಗ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: The ownership of that land now belongs to him.

definition: an abusive remark.
example_en: He uttered an abusive remark in anger.

definition: especially.
example_en: This matter should especially be noted.

definition: the sunlight of the early part of the day:.
example_en: The children were playing in the early morning sunlight.

definition: (pros.) a verse having seventeen syllables in each line.
example_en: The poet wrote a verse in the natkutaka metre of seventeen syllables per line.

definition: a very brief period of time; a moment.
example_en: He came and went in a very brief moment.

definition: (young leaves) to be put forth.
example_en: When spring came, young leaves were put forth on the tree.

definition: finely ground meal of grain as wheat, rice, etc.; flour.
example_en: The shopkeeper filled the rice flour into a bag.

definition: a male sheep.
example_en: The farmer had two male sheep.

definition: several kinds of myrrh-like resins exuded from certain trees, that give fragrant smoke.
example_en: The fragrance of incense resin spread in the temple.

definition: poisoning caused by the toxin produced by botulinus bacteria, usually found in improperly canned or preserved foods, which mayt result often in muscular paralysis and disturbances of vision and breathing; botulism.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಡಬ್ಬಿಯ ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವಿಸಿದವನಿಗೆ ಊರುಬಾಡುಬೇನೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The man who ate food from an old can contracted botulism.

definition: a maxim used to describe that an individual is part of the whole, as a tree is a part of a forest.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ವನವೃಕ್ಷನ್ಯಾಯ ಉದಾಹರಿಸಿ ಸಮಾಜದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬೋಧಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher taught about society by citing the maxim of the tree in the forest.

definition: any of various dark-coloured, viscid products with pungent odour obtained by the destructive distillation of certain organic substances, as coal, peat, shale or wood, used for protecting and preserving surfaces; tar.
example: ರಸ್ತೆಗೆ ಹೊಸ ದಾಂಬರು ಹಾಕುವ ಕೆಲಸ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: Work is going on to lay new tar on the road.

definition: a man who has expert knowledge in artistic quality, ability or work and keen discrimination in art; a connoisseur.
example: ಆ ಕಳಾಭಿಜ್ಞ ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆಯ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That connoisseur noticed the fine details of the painting.

definition: goods stolen or taken by force, as from a captured enemy city in wartime or by dacoits.
example_en: The soldiers brought the plunder from the enemy town.

definition: an oblong piece of cloth used to cover the lower part of the body or as a head-dress.
example_en: He wrapped the cloth as a head-dress around his head.

definition: the quality or fact of being unprecedented.
example_en: The unprecedented nature of that invention astonished the whole world.

definition: used in actual practice or to work out practical problems; applied.
example: ಈ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಆನ್ವಯಿಕ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ.
example_en: This research is a part of applied science.

definition: a man or bird that moves in the sky.
example: ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾರುವ ಆ ಗಗನಚರ ಹಕ್ಕಿಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನೋಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone saw that bird moving in the sky.

definition: to suffer the throes of childbirth; to be in labour.
example_en: She was suffering the throes of childbirth all night.

definition: the hoof-mark of a horse.
example_en: The horse's hoof-mark was clearly visible in the mud.

definition: a head having matted hair.
example_en: That ascetic had a head of matted hair.

definition: any of a genus (Ocimum) of fragrant plants of the mint family, esp. a white-flowered garden herb (Ocimum sanctum which is religiously regarded as a goddess).
example_en: A lamp is burning near the holy basil platform.

definition: to diffuse through the whole of; to spread oneself; to pervade.
example_en: The fog spread over and covered the whole town.

definition: an association or union of merchants.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಗುತ್ತ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳ ಹಿತ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The merchants' association of that town protected the traders' interests.

definition: a man who refuses allegiance to, resists or rises in arms against the government or ruler of his country; a rebel.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡುಗ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಶಸ್ತ್ರ ಹಿಡಿದನು.
example_en: That rebel took up arms against the government.

definition: the ocean, the abode of water.
example_en: The ship floated in the ocean.

definition: a particular kind of religious sacrifice.
example_en: The priests performed the sacrifice called sarvanivedaka.

definition: to emit light (as a burning lamp, candle, etc.).
example_en: The lamp was emitting a flickering light in the dark.

definition: any of various reeds that grow in watery or marshy areas.
example_en: Reeds had grown on the bank of the pond.

definition: 2.the bony framework of the human head; skull.
example_en: The elephant's skull was very strong despite the wound.

definition: to exhaust the strength of by bodily or mental exertion; to get fatigued; to strain oneself.
example_en: Working all day, he exhausted his strength.

definition: having clothes put on; wearing clothes.
example_en: A person wearing proper clothes came to the meeting.

definition: the act of patrolling.
example_en: The soldiers were patrolling all night.

definition: a professional fool or clown, esp. at a royal court; a jester.
example_en: In the palace, the jester's words made everyone laugh.

definition: the quality of being sweet; sweetness.
example_en: Everyone liked the sweetness of this mango.

definition: not attracting attention and hence not demanding care or interest.
example_en: His words were inconspicuous, and no one noticed them.

definition: a yardstick - a) a graduated stick or rod, one yard in length, used in measuring; b) any test or standard used in measuring, judging, etc.
example_en: He measured the cloth with a yardstick.

definition: the plant Ziziphus nummularia ( = Z. rotundifolia) of Rhamnaceae family; wild jujube plant.
example_en: The wild jujube plant had grown on the slope of the hill.

definition: he who lifts, elevates or raises.
example: ಆ ಎತ್ತಿಗ ಭಾರವಾದ ಚೀಲಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಎತ್ತುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That lifter easily lifts heavy sacks.

definition: lasting a very short time; short-lived; transitory; ephemeral.
example_en: That rain stopped in a very short time.

definition: immediately; all of a sudden; unexpectedly; suddenly.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನು ಗಟಗಟನೆ ಎದ್ದು ಓಡಿದ.
example_en: On hearing the news, he suddenly got up and ran.

definition: (dial.) a very precious thing.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಆಭರಣ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಅರಮಾಸಿಪರಮಾಸಿ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That old ornament was a very precious thing to her.

definition: the thick, slimy secretion of the mucous membranes in the nose, that moistens and protects them; mucus of the nose.
example: ಶೀತ ಹಿಡಿದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೂಗಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೊನ್ನಿ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The nose of the child with a cold was full of mucus.

definition: an act of preparing; preparation.
example_en: The preparation needed for the journey was completed.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: His courageous act received praise.

definition: a room, building, etc., in which work (esp. manufacture) is carried on; a workplace.
example_en: Machines are repaired at that workplace.

definition: the star Agena in the constellation Centaurus.
example_en: The star Agena was twinkling in the sky.

definition: glowing with red light (said of twilight).
example_en: The sky glowing with red twilight light was very beautiful to see.

definition: the annual herb Sesamum indicum ( = S. Orientale) of Pedaliaceae family; sesame plant.
example_en: The farmer grows sesame and extracts oil from it.

definition: an embankment of earth, usually surmounted by a parapet, encircling a castle, fort, etc., for defence against attack; a rampart.
example: ಕೋಟೆಯ ಆಳ್ವೆರಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The soldiers were keeping watch on the rampart of the fort.

definition: a servant in a formal official uniform.
example_en: The uniformed servant stood in front of the office.

definition: a thick knot tied by a woman to fasten her sari round her waist.
example_en: She tied a tight knot to fasten her sari.

definition: an acrobatic stunt performed by jumping up, turning the body one full revoluion backward and coming back to the original position.
example_en: The player did a backward somersault and stood straight up.

definition: before that time or period.
example: ಅತ್ತಲಿಂ ಮುನ್ನ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೇವಾಲಯ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Before that time there was a temple here.

definition: a ruthless robbery or plunder.
example: ಆ ಕಳ್ಳರ ಗುಂಪು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಱಿಸೂಱೆ ನಡೆಸಿತು.
example_en: That gang of robbers carried out a ruthless plunder in the village.

definition: a useless, habitually lazy but gluttonous man.
example_en: The lazy glutton does not like to work at all.

definition: to stop on the way; to bring to halt.
example_en: The police stopped the vehicle on the way.

definition: any of a family (Hippopotamyidae) of large, plant-eating, artiodactylous mammals with a heavy, thick-skinned, almost hairless body and short legs: they live chiefly in or near rivers; hippopotamus.
example_en: The hippopotamus was submerged in the river water.

definition: to join or attach together; to conjoin; to connect; to combine; to unite.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಎರಡು ತುಣುಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sculptor joined the two pieces together and made an idol.

definition: to separate; to divide.
example_en: The farmer separated the crops according to type.

definition: to be in chorus or unison.
example_en: All the singers sang in unison, in chorus.

definition: a factory for rolling metal into various shapes between rolls; a rolling mill.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉರುಳೆಗಿರಣಿಯೊಂದು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಹಾಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In that town, a rolling mill manufactures iron sheets.

definition: an adhesive substance, as glue; an adhesive.
example: ಬಡಗಿಯು ಮರದ ತುಂಡುಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಱಿ ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter applied adhesive glue and joined the pieces of wood.

definition: the plant Glycosmis cohinchinensis of Rutaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the Glycosmis cohinchinensis plant are used for medicine.

definition: to cause to go away (from).
example_en: The mother made the stone go away from the child's hand.

definition: a shaft with a sharp point at one end.
example_en: That pointed shaft was made of iron.

definition: to rub gently; to move one's hand, a cloth, etc. over (a surface or object) with pressure and friction, in a circular or back-and-forth motion.
example_en: She gently rubbed the table with a cloth.

definition: the scorching sunlight of the mid-day.
example_en: The scorching mid-day sun was burning the whole field.

definition: a flower in the heavens.
example_en: That dream, like a flower in the sky, never came true.

definition: (phil.) the belief that the natural world, as explained by scientific laws, is all that exists and that there is no supernatural or spiritual creation, control or significance; naturalism.
example_en: That philosopher strongly advocated naturalism.

definition: an unworthy king.
example_en: The subjects suffered under the unworthy king's rule.

definition: a battle or combat.
example_en: The combat between the two warriors amazed the people.

definition: attractiveness; loveliness; beauty.
example_en: The loveliness of her face attracted everyone.

definition: a kind of plant.
example: ತೋಟದ ಬೇಲಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಗೀರು ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A gīru plant had grown near the garden fence.

definition: a dying at will; death at will.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ಧ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಚ್ಛಾಮರಣ ಹೊಂದಿದನೆಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: It is said that the saint attained death at will while in meditation.

definition: a man excommunicated by his kinsmen.
example_en: The man excommunicated by his kinsmen lived alone outside the village.

definition: the practice of robbery.
example_en: That gang was skilled in the practice of robbery.

definition: open organised, and armed resistance to one's government or ruler.
example_en: The people rose in rebellion against the government.

definition: the act of sprinkling water.
example_en: The earth became cool due to the sprinkling of rain water.

definition: a royal family.
example_en: The scions of the royal family ruled the land.

definition: that which has scales; a fish.
example_en: The fisherman caught the fish in the net.

definition: sameness of nature, identity, unity.
example: ಆತ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಮಾತ್ಮನ ನಡುವಿನ ತಾದಾತ್ಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಂತರು ವಿವರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The saints explained the oneness between the soul and the supreme soul.

definition: name of a plant.
example_en: They use the Binike plant for medicine.

definition: sediment precipitated from a liquid; solid particles of a liquid forming a residue; dregs.
example_en: Sediment had accumulated in the oil container.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard; to protect.
example_en: The father protected the child from danger.

definition: to be or get, beautified ornamented.
example_en: The pavilion decorated with flowers became beautifully ornamented.

definition: a deep and tender feeling of affection for or attachment or devotion to a person or persons; friendly feeling or attitude; love; affection; friendship.
example_en: There was deep affection between the two of them.

definition: a magician by profession.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮಾಯಾಜೀವಿ ಜನರನ್ನು ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: In that town, a professional magician used to amaze the people.

definition: an insolvent man; a bankrupt.
example_en: That bankrupt man could not repay his debts.

definition: a collection, bunch of flowers.
example_en: A bunch of flowers was prepared for the worship.

definition: to cause to announce something in public.
example_en: The king ordered the minister to have the news announced.

definition: that branch of medicine, which deals with the treatment of human beings.
example_en: That doctor is an expert in the field of human medicine.

definition: to pass or spend time.
example_en: They spent the time chatting away.

definition: to drown deep (in water); to run aground.
example_en: The boat struck the rock and ran aground.

definition: a pot-bellied woman.
example_en: Being a pot-bellied woman, she found it very hard to walk.

definition: a delicate, soft odour (of a perfume).
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನ ಎಳಗಂಪು ಮನೆಯ ತುಂಬಾ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The delicate fragrance of that flower spread through the whole house.

definition: a girl who has recently attained menstrual stage.
example_en: They decorated the girl who had recently attained menstrual stage for the ceremony.

definition: a person who is dejected; a despondent woman.
example_en: The dejected woman sat in the corner and wept.

definition: a sound.
example_en: The sound of the night wind was heard.

definition: generating; producing; giving forth; causing.
example_en: The sun is the power that is generating light.

definition: a tradesman; a merchant; a trader.
example_en: That trader used to bring goods from distant towns.

definition: (dance.) any of the single-handed gestures in dancing.
example_en: In the dance, the teacher taught the single-handed gestures.

definition: a degenerative disease of later life, characterised by a rhythmic tremor and muscular rigidity, caused by degeneration in the basal ganglia of the brain; Parkinson's disease.
example_en: Grandfather began showing symptoms of Parkinson's disease.

definition: that is payable.
example_en: This instalment is payable next month.

definition: to make sharp or sharper; to sharpen.
example_en: He sharpened the tip of the arrow.

definition: to cause to say, utter something or make a statement.
example_en: The guru made the disciple recite the verse.

definition: a water jar.
example_en: They had placed a filled water jar in front of the temple.

definition: a brown or black tarlike substance, a variety of bitumen, found in a natural state or obtained by evaporating petroleum; asphalt.
example_en: They use asphalt for road repairs.

definition: an earnet request as for help, justice, etc.; an appeal; a petition.
example_en: The woman who had suffered injustice made an earnest appeal to the court.

definition: a pleasing speech, esp. eulogistic or laudatory one.
example_en: The king praised the poet with pleasing words and honoured him.

definition: a large city.
example_en: Thousands of people lived in that large city.

definition: nomad - a) any wanderer who has no fixed home ; b) a member of a tribe or people having no permanent home, but moving about constantly in search of food, pasture, etc.
example: ಆ ಅಲೆಮಾರಿ ಜನ ಒಂದು ಊರಿನಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಊರಿಗೆ ವಲಸೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Those nomadic people migrate from one town to another.

definition: the three worlds, the heaven, earth and nether world.
example: ಶಿವನು ಮೂವಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಆಳುವ ದೇವನೆಂದು ಕವಿ ಬಣ್ಣಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet described Shiva as the god who rules all the three worlds.

definition: a literary work that is a deliberate copy of or that exaggerates the style of another writer; a parody.
example: ಆ ಬರಹಗಾರ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕವಿಯ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಣಕವಾಡು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That writer wrote a parody in the style of the famous poet.

definition: greatness; eminence; superiority; distinction.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ಬುಲ್ಲಣಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone was talking about that poet's greatness.

definition: air taken into the lungs and then let out; breath.
example_en: His breath was fast.

definition: (a leg) to become crippled.
example_en: His leg became crippled due to the accident.

definition: (a mosquito, bee, etc.) to make a sound like that of a prolonged z.
example_en: A mosquito was buzzing inside the room.

definition: the lotus plant.
example_en: The lotus plant stood blooming in the water.

definition: a handbag with shoulder strap attached; a shoulder-bag.
example_en: She filled her shoulder-bag with books.

definition: a pasty preparation spread on cloth and applied to the body, used medicinally as a curative or counter-irritant; a plaster.
example_en: The doctor applied a plaster to the swollen leg.

definition: bestowing wealth.
example: ಆ ದಾನಿ ಧನದನಾಗಿ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That donor, bestowing wealth, helped the poor.

definition: a man who rows a boat; a boatman.
example_en: The boatman brought the boat to the shore and stopped it.

definition: the ghee that is solidified.
example_en: In the sun the solidified ghee became firm.

definition: the lobe of the ear.
example_en: Due to the wound, the lobe of his ear had swollen.

definition: (astrol.) the planet Rāhu.
example_en: The astrologers examined the position of Rahu in the horoscope.

definition: a tooth that is disorderly set in the jaw.
example: ಅವನ ಬಾಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಲ್ಲು ಮಂಟವಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: One tooth in his mouth has grown disorderly set in the jaw.

definition: an internal lattice-like structure to hold something up (esp. for a pandal).
example_en: They built the internal lattice structure of the pandal with bamboo.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The farmer identified the gōdi barmoṇḍa plant in the field.

definition: Yamunā river, one of the major rivers of North India.
example_en: Krishna grew up on the banks of the Yamuna.

definition: the act or speaking.
example_en: The guru's discourse inspired everyone.

definition: a wide extent of level country; a plain land.
example_en: The cows were grazing in the green plain land.

definition: feeling resentment against someone because of that person's rivalry, success or advantages; jealosy.
example: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕಿಜ್ರ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his friend's success, he felt jealousy.

definition: speech affected by stammering.
example_en: His stammering speech was not understood by the people.

definition: the research work carried on for studying the life and culture of past, by excavating ancient cities, sites, relics, etc.; archaeological research.
example: ಆ ತಂಡ ಹಳೆಯ ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾಕ್ತನಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸಿತು.
example_en: That team carried out archaeological research in the old city.

definition: to press or beat with the feet so as to crush or injure; to tread; to trample.
example_en: The elephant trampled the flower garden and destroyed it.

definition: a thing that has actually happened or that is really true; fact.
example_en: The actual fact was not recorded in the report.

definition: mental agony; anguish.
example_en: The news of her son's death caused the mother deep mental anguish.

definition: a firm, motionless position.
example_en: Hearing the thunder, the child stood motionless and still.

definition: the food served for eating or eaten.
example_en: At the wedding they served the food on banana leaves.

definition: a group of persons; a crowd; a gathering.
example_en: A large crowd had gathered in front of the temple.

definition: rice in husk; paddy.
example_en: The farmer is drying the paddy in the threshing floor.

definition: an interjection for calling a wife or an inferior woman.
example: ಅಣೆ, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾ ಎಂದು ಅವಳನ್ನು ಕರೆದನು.
example_en: He called her saying, 'Hey, come here.'

definition: not having or leaving behind, a shadow.
example_en: That lamp was shining without leaving a shadow.

definition: (of time or space) the extent from end to end.
example_en: The dimension of this room is small.

definition: (a rumour, gossip, hearsay) to be spread widely.
example_en: A rumour spread widely in the village about that news.

definition: suddenly and with a fluttering sound (as a bird).
example_en: The bird flew away suddenly with a fluttering sound.

definition: to form, develop or hold in the mind as an image or concept.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅವಧಾನಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet formed a beautiful image in his mind.

definition: a kind of vīṇe, the Indian lute.
example_en: The kinnara veena resounded sweetly in the temple.

definition: aversion or disinclination to work or exert oneself; the quality of being indisposed to action or exertion; laziness; sluggishness.
example_en: Because of his laziness, the work was not finished on time.

definition: a small or short branch of a tree.
example_en: That small branch broke and fell.

definition: the condition of boiling violently with bubbling sound.
example_en: Violent bubbling boiling started in the pot on the stove.

definition: harassment; molestation; annoyance.
example_en: She became weary of the neighbour's harassment.

definition: the act of joining or uniting.
example: ಎರಡು ಗ್ರಾಮಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಜಲ ಸಂಧಾನ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: A joining of water channels was made between the two villages.

definition: that which is well-knitted or well-woven.
example_en: That cloth was very well-woven.

definition: the coniferous tree Pinus palustris of Pinaceae family; turpentine tree.
example_en: People extract turpentine oil from the turpentine tree.

definition: a moving in a zig-zag, crooked course.
example_en: The river's zig-zag course made rowing the boat difficult.

definition: the act of smearing, daubing.
example_en: The lime plastering on the wall has not yet dried.
